---
name: Audit correction
about: Something in one of the audits under audits/ is wrong or out of date
title: "Audit correction: <owner>/<repo>"
labels: audit-correction
---

**Which audit:** `audits/<owner>_<repo>/audit.md`

**What is wrong:** quote the sentence or number.

**What is correct, and the evidence:** a file and line in your repository, a commit, or documentation.

**Are you a maintainer of the audited project?** yes / no

Corrections are added to the audit under "Owner response" (or "Corrections"), with the date.
